purpose: Separate one-step myopic EVI correctness and model-prior calibration from long-horizon terminal high-context loss, after KNOW27 FIT entropy outperformed FIT EVI. This is a distinct synthetic new cohort, NOT another phase-memory or x2-affordance study.
role: Independent source-only contribution; existing PR #1327, sole canonical learner/integration owner Amalgam PR #1278. No protected original world #426 actions, no native checkpoint, accepted main, owner runner, deployment, scheduler, new PR or paid APIs.
hypothesis: Is frozen myopic EVI internally a correct one-step Bayesian high-context Brier reduction yet inferior to entropy on long-horizon structured-law sources because the EVI objective and learned prior are misaligned? Compare EVI vs entropy on model-prior-matched and structured-distribution cohorts under same historical FIT and 32 public action budgets.
model: Exact frozen KNOW26 six anonymous mapping hypotheses × 256 binary truth tables, uniform fresh-law prior and source-trained 108 FIT actions per historical mapping group. Same model capacity/checkpoint/updates in EVI/entropy/cyclic/random; NOFIT entropy uses uniform map prior; privileged true-map entropy 256-laws is an explicitly not-fair reference. No new native training or teacher.

worlds.public: At each t=0..31 public context c=t%4, action labels a in 0..3; action0 no-op, other physical effects hidden; one Bernoulli(.85 if hidden table bit at c xor hidden map[a] else .15) witnessed for action actually chosen. No counterfactual reward, hidden law or map in policy.
worlds.fit: Re-read the exact already-consumed KNOW26 108 FIT witnessed source events per true-map group solely as historical training, creating one frozen learned posterior map prior per group. Do not re-score KNOW26 HELD or KNOW27 HELD.

model_prior_matched.map_prior: For each map training group, evaluator samples private mapping from FIT learned categorical posterior by SHA256('know29:private:map:v1:'+group+':'+seed_index) first64 normalized; learner never receives selected mapping.
model_prior_matched.law: For each group and seed, evaluator samples a uniform truth table integer 0..255 from SHA256('know29:private:law:v1:'+group+':'+seed) first8 bytes modulo 256. Fits the candidate family/prior exactly conditional on historical FIT.

structured_shift.map_prior: Same private mapping sampling mechanism as prior-matched, disjoint source SHA domain.
structured_shift.law: Four predeclared Boolean formulas, assigned round-robin among 8 seeds: x0 XOR (x1 OR x2); x2 XOR (x0 AND x1); ((NOT x0) AND x1) XOR x2; (x0 OR x1) AND x2. All representable in 256-table model but population distribution differs strongly from uniform.

worlds.noise: Private SHA256('know29:private:coin:v1:'+cohort+':'+group+':'+seed+':'+t) first64/2**64, shared exogenous coin per step across policies and independent of selected action, no hidden readback to policy.

selection.fit_evi: Existing KNOW27 exact high-context expected Bernoulli Brier reduction minus 0.002 action cost, myopic; policy sees only current joint posterior and public c.
selection.fit_entropy: Existing KNOW27 predictive outcome Bernoulli variance q(1-q) minus same 0.002 cost; strongest fair conventional policy, not a new learned model.
selection.nofit_entropy: Same joint Bayes hypothesis count, entropy and held evidence budget but no 108 historical FIT actions. Count extra FIT as data/compute, not parity.
selection.fit_cyclic: Public t mod 4 actions; same FIT model and 32 held observations.
selection.fit_random: Public RNG seeded by predeclared world ordinal independent of private map/law/noise; same FIT model and 32 held observations.
selection.privileged_known_map_entropy: Correct private physical map in model, 256 Boolean law hypotheses; extra-private-information ceiling, NOT a matched fair control.
selection.passive_p05: Uninformed .5 prediction no training, 32 no-op witnessed actions, an unprivileged floor.
selection.equivalence: Policies receive 32 chosen-action observations each, same source coin per time but different observed y as intended adaptive difference. Model capacity same for EVI/entropy/cyclic/random only. Extra historical FIT cost separately reported.

math_control: On at least the empty prior and one non-private toy witness state, independently recompute expected reduction in four high-context posterior Brier forecast uncertainty by enumerating both possible next y and cold-cloned one-witness updates; match KNOW27 closed-form EVI score including .002 cost within 1e-10. This is a deterministic mathematical identity, not a held result.
metrics: For each cohort/arm: mean terminal analytic expected Brier on 4 high c=4..7 public no-op contexts, mean net Brier=high Brier+.002*nonzero_action_count/768, per historical map-group losses, action count, checkpoint bytes, CPU/wall, one witnessed event per action, cold exact replay, no source/private leakage. Report EVI-minus-entropy cohort differences, 24-world descriptive distribution, no population significance claim.

frozen_decisions.H1: Exact one-step EVI high-posterior-Brier utility identity against independent two-outcome enumeration, max absolute error <=1e-10 for at least two posterior states and all four actions.
frozen_decisions.H2: In model-prior-matched 24-world cohort, FIT EVI has net terminal high Brier <= FIT entropy minus 0.005 absolute.
frozen_decisions.H3: In structured-shift 24-world cohort, FIT entropy has net terminal high Brier <= FIT EVI minus 0.005 absolute.
frozen_decisions.H4: FIT EVI vs no-FIT entropy cannot be miscalled data-matched: 108 historical FIT actions per map group counted as extra cost and source, and privileged arm flagged extra map info.
frozen_decisions.gate: Engineering requires frozen source, single-witness typing/cold replay, original protected source denial, two-OS full source regression and deterministic source-only report. Scientific interpretation of source-only trial may be MECHANISM_CALIBRATION_SUPPORTED_DEV only if H1,H2,H3 hold; otherwise MIXED/NO_GO. Never SCIENTIFIC_PASS or canonical promotion.
frozen_decisions.limits: Small correlated, hand-chosen 24-world cohorts, models conventional exact Bayes, no native Yggdrasil learning, no unfamiliar original natural world, no clinical/real-world inference or intelligence claim.

first_use: Only new synthetic HELD cohorts become consumed on first scheduled existing GitHub Actions study step after focused tests, source atlas, Linux/Windows final regression and historical-source compatibility pass. Unit tests never generate new HELD witness streams. No replay/new scores after outcomes to retune; fix engineering before held first-use or stop if uncertainty.
